penalties_range: Up to BHD 20k fine; up to 1 year prison
exemptions: Art. 2: excludes individual processing for personal/family affairs; public security processing by Defence, Interior, National Guard, NSS, other security bodies
notes: Law No. 30 of 2018; Ministry of Justice exercises Authority functions under a 2019 decree

jurisdiction: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT)
key_requirements: Consent (guardian consent for children), ministry permit for sensitive data, breach notification, cross-border transfer rules
retention_period: Controller/processor keep processing documents for retention period set by Executive Regulation (MD 34/2024); breach fine OMR 1,000-5,000 (article unconfirmed)
enforcement_authority: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT)
penalties_range: Up to OMR 500k fine (admin fines up to OMR 2k)
exemptions: Art. 3: national security/public interest; State bodies' competences; legal/court obligation; vital interests; crime detection; personal/family use; research
notes: Royal Decree 6/2022; replaced e-Transactions Law ch. 7; Executive Regulation in force 5 Feb 2024

applies_to: Public & private entities processing personal data
key_requirements: Consent, data subject rights, controller and processor duties, warning before penalties

penalties_range: Up to JOD 10k per violation (doubled if repeated)
exemptions: Art. 4(A) consent exceptions: research, statistics, national security, public interest, data made public by subject, CBJ entities; personal-purpose use excluded
notes: Law No. 24 of 2023; grace period for existing processing ended Mar 2025

law_name: Law No. 09-08 on the Protection of Individuals with regard to the Processing of Personal Data (Law 09-08)
jurisdiction: National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP)
applies_to: Controllers established in Morocco or using means in Morocco
key_requirements: Prior declaration or CNDP authorization, consent, data subject rights, authorization for transfers to non-adequate countries
retention_period: Art. 3: data kept in identifiable form for no longer than necessary for the purposes for which collected and processed (limited retention principle)
enforcement_authority: National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP)
penalties_range: Up to MAD 300,000 and/or up to 2 years imprisonment (criminal); CNDP warnings, notices, authorisation withdrawal
exemptions: Personal or household use; national security & defense; crime prevention; journalistic/literary/artistic activities
notes: Dahir 1-09-15 of 18 Feb 2009; Bulletin Officiel 5714 of 5 Mar 2009; Decree 2-09-165 implements it

applies_to: Public & private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: Controller registration, data protection principles, data subject rights
retention_period: s.24: not retained longer than necessary for purpose unless required by law, lawful function, contract or consent; research/statistics exceptions
penalties_range: Up to 5,000 penalty units and/or 10 years' imprisonment
notes: Registration certificate valid 2 years; a 2025 replacement bill is still only a draft

jurisdiction: Commission de protection des données personnelles (CDP)
key_requirements: Prior declaration or authorisation, consent, data subject rights
retention_period: Art. 35: data kept no longer than necessary for the purposes for which collected or processed
enforcement_authority: Commission de protection des données personnelles (CDP)
penalties_range: CDP fines of XOF 1M to 100M; up to 7 years' imprisonment (Penal Code)
notes: Entry-into-force day unconfirmed (set to enactment date); 2019 replacement bill not adopted

key_requirements: Consent, prior authorisation for sensitive data, cross-border transfer limits
retention_period: Art. 16: data kept only for a period not exceeding that necessary for collection/processing purposes; ARTCI sets case-specific periods in decisions
enforcement_authority: Autorité de régulation des télécommunications/TIC de Côte d'Ivoire (ARTCI)
penalties_range: Up to XOF 10M (repeat within 5 years: up to XOF 100M or 5% of pre-tax turnover) (unconfirmed)
notes: Entry-into-force day unconfirmed (set to enactment date); ARTCI is designated data protection authority

applies_to: Public & private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: Registration with the PDPO, consent, data subject rights
retention_period: s.18: not retained longer than necessary for purpose unless required/authorised by law, lawful purpose, contract or data subject consent
enforcement_authority: Personal Data Protection Office (PDPO) within NITA-U
penalties_range: Up to 245 currency points or 2% of annual gross turnover (corporations); up to 10 years' imprisonment
notes: Gazetted 3 May 2019 (some sources give that as commencement); Regulations 2021

law_name: Law Relating to the Protection of Personal Data and Privacy (Law No. 058/2021)
key_requirements: Lawful processing principles, DPO and impact assessments, breach notification, cross-border transfer rules
retention_period: Art. 52: keep data until processing purposes are fulfilled; longer if authorised by law, required by contract or consent; retention schedule required
penalties_range: Admin fine RWF 2M-5M or 1% global turnover; criminal fines up to 5% of turnover; up to 7 years' imprisonment
notes: Two-year transition for existing controllers ended 15 Oct 2023

applies_to: Public & private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: Registration with the PDPC, consent, data subject rights
retention_period: s.5 principles: data kept in identifiable form only for as long as necessary for the purpose of processing
notes: Commenced 1 May 2023 by notice; registration deadline extended to 30 Apr 2025; assent day from one source

jurisdiction: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner
applies_to: Public & private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: Registration of controllers and processors, licensing of data auditors, data subject rights
retention_period: s.12 principles: stored in a form permitting identification no longer than necessary for the purposes of processing
enforcement_authority: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner
penalties_range: Up to 500,000 penalty units and/or 5 years' imprisonment
notes: Commenced by SI 22 of 2021; Office operational only from 2025; registration due 30 Apr 2025

jurisdiction: Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ)
applies_to: Public & private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: Data controller licensing, consent, data subject rights
retention_period: s.7 (Quality of data): kept in identifiable form no longer than necessary for purposes of collection or further processing

penalties_range: Fine up to level 11 and/or up to 7 years' imprisonment
notes: Act 5 of 2021 [Chapter 12:07]; gazetted 11 Mar 2022; enactment day from one source; licensing under SI 155/2024

applies_to: Public & private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: GDPR-aligned principles, controller registration, data subject rights
retention_period: Duty to destroy/erase personal data once purpose of collection no longer served (s.27 per secondary source); retention period must be disclosed at collection (unconfirmed)
penalties_range: Up to MUR 200000 fine and/or 5 years' imprisonment
notes: Replaced the Data Protection Act 2004; commenced by Proclamation No. 3 of 2018

applies_to: Public & private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: Consent, purpose limitation, data subject rights

penalties_range: Up to BWP 50M fine and/or imprisonment
notes: Replaced 2018 Act (never operative); start date disputed: 2024-10-29 vs 2025-01-14

key_requirements: APD registration and authorisation, consent, data subject rights
retention_period: Art. 11: principle of duration of retention period - data kept only for period necessary for processing purposes
notes: Entry-into-force day unconfirmed (set to law date); APD operating since Oct 2019; revision still draft

applies_to: Public & private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: Authority authorisation before processing, breach notification within 72 hours, cross-border transfer limits
retention_period: Art. 15 storage limitation (unofficial text): retain for reasonable period needed for purpose or as set by law; longer for law, consent, research/statistics
penalties_range: Up to 4% of worldwide turnover (entities); up to 10 years' imprisonment and ETB 300000 fines
